messages:
marta: Quick heads-up, I'm opening a small PR to refresh the 'starter-surge' quickstart: switch auth examples to use a .env pattern, update the Dockerfile to a multi-stage build, add a GH Actions secret one-liner, and a short 'do not commit creds' callout. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4972

ben: Nice. Can you paste the Dockerfile snippet here so I can eyeball it quickly?

marta: Pasting minimalist Dockerfile from the PR:

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY pyproject.toml requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt -t /build/.deps

FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /build/.deps /app/.deps
COPY --chown=1000:1000 . /app
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/.deps:/app
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

tara: LGTM. Two tiny asks: 1) show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` for local dev and a 2-line .env example so people don't paste tokens, 2) include a one-liner for setting the secret in GH Actions (`echo \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | gh secret set REDWOOD_API_KEY`).

marta: Added both to the PR and a minimal workflow example referencing the quickstart. Also replaced any examples that printed tokens with placeholders.

phil: Make sure the code example uses `client.generate()` (current SDK pattern) and not the old `generate_text` shim. If you post the snippet I can sanity-check it.

marta: Confirmed `client.generate()` used. I ran a local smoke with a mock client.

link-bot: link-check: found one stale link in docs/quickstarts/starter-surge.md -> ./old-auth.md; suggested replacement: ../auth/getting-started.md

marta: Thanks, patched the link in the PR. I'll address any remaining review comments and merge after CI. Ping me here for final tweaks. :shipit:
